aria_snapshot:
- main:
  - region "Every city is a doorway.":
    - paragraph: The Cauldron is listening
    - heading "Every city is a doorway." [level=1]
    - paragraph: Turn the Earth. Find a signal. Select a city to descend from orbit to its boundary.
    - 'link "Earth imagery: NASA Blue Marble"':
      - /url: https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/blue-marble-next-generation/base-map/
    - text: Move across a city signal Click or touch to approach its boundary
  - region "The portal remembers who made it.":
    - paragraph: Earth is only the beginning
    - heading "The portal remembers who made it." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Espil built the Cauldron. Lunaris keeps its laws. Leo struck the coin that moves between worlds. Their work begins here—among familiar cities carrying unfamiliar signals.
    - list "Three figures of the Cauldron":
      - listitem:
        - text: "01"
        - strong: Espil
        - text: Maker of the Cauldron
      - listitem:
        - text: "02"
        - strong: Lunaris
        - text: Keeper of its rules
      - listitem:
        - text: "03"
        - strong: Leo
        - text: Maker of Leocoin
  - region "Speak with the maker.":
    - strong: Espil
    - text: Cauldron maker · Signal 01
    - paragraph: A voice between worlds
    - heading "Speak with the maker." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Espil listens for the frequency beneath a question. Ask about the Cauldron, beauty, trust, or the world waiting beyond the first gate.
    - text: Espil agent preview In-page character dialogue Espil You found the signal, 그대. What would you ask of the one who made the Cauldron?
    - button "What is the Cauldron?"
    - button "What do you value?"
    - button "Something unexpected"
    - text: Ask Espil a question
    - textbox "Ask Espil a question"
    - button "Send question"
  - region "Be there when Zealandia surfaces.":
    - paragraph: Answer the summons
    - heading "Be there when Zealandia surfaces." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Join the early list for launch news and the first invitation through the Cauldron.
    - link "Join the waitlist":
      - /url: https://espil.online/waitlist
- contentinfo: ESPIL Online An original adventure · Arriving December 2026
